pulse.text: **Quiet three hours on releases** - nothing has shipped since Tencent's Hy4 preview on Aug 28 - but the release radar moved hard. Polymarket's book on Google's next Gemini Pro landing **by Oct 31 collapsed to 47% from 73%** last sweep, turning Gemini 3.5 Pro from probable into a coin flip, though that leg carries only $4.9K of the market's $1.18M. Anthropic's next Mythos-class model went the other way, **jumping to 36% for today from 28%** while easing to 89% by Sep 30, and OpenAI's Astra firmed to 93% by Oct 31 but still shows just 69% by Sep 15. The **$3.24M August best-model market resolves at noon ET today with Anthropic at 99.3%**, effectively a formality with Claude Opus 5 leading the AA-Index at **63** over Fable 5 at 62 and Grok 4.6 and GPT-5.6 Sol tied at 61. Elsewhere, traders raised the odds that some model clears 90% on FrontierMath before 2027 to **89% from 83%**, and the only data addition this sweep is IBM's Granite 4.2 3B, the small Apache 2.0 sibling of the 8B and 30B; the Mythos market's Sep 9 leg at 75% is the next thing to watch.
